{{Quote|Got it!|Sila Kott|<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />}}
'''Sila Kott'''<ref name="Hasbro" /> was a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who fought and [[Death/Legends|died]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Kott's [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] was part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], in which the pilot served as [[Red Three/Legends|Red Three]]. Kott was shot down by two [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] in the attempt to lead them away.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Anyway, that A-wing pilot is a British woman who was voiced over by an American guy.|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28138124|board=Literature|thread=Female pilots and the like|user=[[Pablo Hidalgo|Pabawan]]|date=2008-02-28|time=12:26 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171026102028/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/female-pilots-and-the-like.28135771}}</ref>}}
Although played by British actress [[Poppy Hands]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], Sila Kott was later dubbed by a male actor.<ref name="JCF" /> In [[2011]], original, unedited footage of Hands playing Sila Kott was included on the ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'' Blu-ray release, speaking dialogue in her actual voice after being prompted by an off-camera crew member.<ref name="Blu-ray">Battle of Endor: The Lost Rebels (''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' deleted scene)&mdash;''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>

In ''Return of the Jedi'', Kott responds to a command from Wedge Antilles of "Red Three, [[Red Two/Legends|Red Two]], pull in." Later in the Battle of Endor, a [[Red Two (Battle of Endor)|Y-wing pilot]] is called "Red Two" by Antilles, thereby suggesting that Kott is Red Three.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> However, the [[Hasbro]] action figure set "Battle Over Endor," names Red Two as Kott's [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]],<ref name="Hasbro" /> and the line "Got it!" is similarly attributed to Red Two in both ''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''<ref name="Annotated Screenplays">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref> and the [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|junior novelization]] of ''Return of the Jedi''.<ref name="ROTJ junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> This article defers to ''Return of the Jedi'' itself and assumes that in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, Kott is in fact Red Three.

The character also should not be confused with [[Green Leader/Legends|Green Leader]] [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]];<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> nevertheless, Crynyd's line "Three of them coming in, twenty degrees!" is attributed to "Red Three" in ''The Annotated Screenplays''<ref name="Annotated Screenplays" />, the junior novelization,<ref name="ROTJ junior novel" /> and the [[Return of the Jedi (radio)|radio drama]],<ref name="NPR Dramatization">[[Return of the Jedi: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''Return of the Jedi'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref> even though in the film, the line is actually spoken by Crynyd ''after'' Kott's A-wing is destroyed.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />
